new_issues_post_integration.issue: The implementation does not instantiate the schema it designs. init_manifest writes specs: {}, so exec-state.sh next returns ALL_DONE and check T1.1 returns unknown, causing the required executor guard to skip or block every real spec.
new_issues_post_integration.evidence: Schema is shown at lines 2837-2883, but the actual init at lines 2913-2923 writes an empty specs object.
new_issues_post_integration.fix: Generate the manifest from the full 30-spec schema in init_manifest and make check distinguish unknown from completed instead of treating unknown as do-not-run.

new_issues_post_integration.issue: SQLite snapshot adoption breaks rollback: T-1 archives .claude/memory.db.snapshot-${DATE}, while G3 verifies/restores ~/.claude/memory.db. Extraction will not replace a corrupted memory.db.
new_issues_post_integration.evidence: T-1 archives only the snapshot at line 2625; G3 verifies memory.db existence at lines 1384-1395.
new_issues_post_integration.fix: Archive snapshot under a restore path or add G3 logic to move/copy .claude/memory.db.snapshot-${BACKUP_ID} to .claude/memory.db and verify PRAGMA integrity_check after restore.

new_issues_post_integration.issue: Backup scripts treat optional paths as mandatory. On this machine ~/.claude/commands is missing, and shell glob handling around LaunchAgents can also abort. T-1 can fail before Wave 0.
new_issues_post_integration.evidence: T-1 includes .claude/commands at line 2622 and notes missing paths are okay at line 2644, but current filesystem check shows ~/.claude/commands is absent.
new_issues_post_integration.fix: Build an explicit file list with existence checks, create missing directories before backup, or use tar include files generated by find rather than literal optional paths/globs.

new_issues_post_integration.issue: The Keychain write command is wrong for macOS security CLI. security add-generic-password -w - does not read stdin; it treats '-' as the password or prompts depending mode, so the stored PG_PASSWORD_RO can differ from the role password.
new_issues_post_integration.evidence: Spec uses echo -n "$PG_PASSWORD_RO" | security ... -w - at line 6380; security usage says -w expects a password argument.
new_issues_post_integration.fix: Use security add-generic-password without -w to prompt, or use a temporary file/osascript/keychain-safe helper verified by retrieving and comparing length/hash without printing the secret.

new_issues_post_integration.issue: Gemini's supply-chain pinning concern is not actually integrated. The plan still uses @latest, docker :latest, unpinned npx packages, and unpinned qdrant MCP.
new_issues_post_integration.evidence: Playwright uses @latest at lines 4923 and 4954; GitHub pulls latest at line 5167 and npx unpinned at line 5160; Qdrant uses npx -y mcp-server-qdrant at line 6493.
new_issues_post_integration.fix: Pin exact versions or digests, record hashes in T-1 inventory, and add verification commands before registering MCP servers.

new_issues_post_integration.issue: Gemini's plist-secret fix was applied to G4 but not to T1.5. T1.5 still proposes TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN inside LaunchAgent EnvironmentVariables.
new_issues_post_integration.evidence: T1.5 plist block includes TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN at lines 4638-4645.
new_issues_post_integration.fix: Use the same ~/.config/nuzantara/.env.secret or Keychain retrieval pattern as G4 and add a grep verification that no token/password/secret appears in the plist.

new_issues_post_integration.issue: The spec assumes ~/.claude/commands exists, but it is missing on this machine and the implementation never mkdir -p's it before writing command files.
new_issues_post_integration.evidence: Step 1 only runs ls at lines 7125-7130; current filesystem check shows ~/.claude/commands missing.
new_issues_post_integration.fix: Add mkdir -p ~/.claude/commands before Step 2 and include it in T-1 as a directory that may be created if absent.

compositional_issues.issue: The plan says T2.5 will include the execution manifest, but the T2.5 implementation does not contain the Step 4 manifest-reading code from T-2. Compaction still loses spec progress.
compositional_issues.fix: Patch the T2.5 hook body itself to read orchestration-execution-manifest.json and add a test asserting execution_manifest exists in the handoff.

compositional_issues.issue: The guardrail blocks Edit/Write on .mcp.json but later MCP install specs may require project .mcp.json edits. There is no documented safe override path, so the plan can deadlock after installing its own guardrail.
compositional_issues.fix: Define an explicit operator-approved bypass token or a narrow allowlist for specific setup scripts, and test install flows after T1.2 is active.

compositional_issues.issue: G4 moves Telegram secrets into ~/.config/nuzantara/.env.secret, but T-1 backs up .config/nuzantara/ into an unencrypted tarball. The secret leaves the plist only to be captured in the global backup.
compositional_issues.fix: Exclude secret values from T-1 tarballs; backup only keychain item names and file metadata, or encrypt the backup before adding .config/nuzantara.

compositional_issues.issue: Final validation still uses gameable and task-insensitive proxies: /verify count, newest transcript grep, linear Agent-call targets, and no independent tool-output audit.
